entities.name: UniProt Q8K991
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Buchnera aphidicola trigger factor; annotated as a chaperone and peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase (EC 5.2.1.8).
Trigger factor PFAM domains: Trigger_N at residues 1–144 and Trigger_C at residues 269–414.

entities.name: Peptidyl-proline isomerization
observations: Catalyzes reversible cis-trans isomerization about the peptide bond preceding proline: protein-peptidylproline (omega=180) = protein-peptidylproline (omega=0); EC 5.2.1.8, RHEA:16237.
